title: No-network lint never verifies DEMO_INTERCEPTED against demo_update.handle — r2 'manual manifest' gap did not bite
evidence:
# in-memory store. Keep this in sync with the request messages in
# demo_update.handle — a message listed here must have a demo arm there.
...
    path = "client/src/client.gleam"
    lines = open(path).read().splitlines()
detail: The r3 bar requires the manifest machine-verified with a manifest-drift bite-test. The script opens only client.gleam; demo_update.gleam is never read, sync is manual per the docstring, and no bite-test harness exists (only test.yml invokes the script). Deleting a demo arm would pass the lint while the real api call falls through in demo mode.
recommended_fix: Parse demo_update.handle arms and fail on DEMO_INTERCEPTED entries lacking a demo arm (and stray arms not listed); add a bite-test that runs the lint against synthetic manifest drift and asserts exit 1.

title: demo_mode guard window is a flat 35-line slice, not arm-bounded — a cross-arm guard still satisfies the lint
evidence:
window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx])
        guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window
detail: The arm boundary found by the backward scan is used only for the exempt/intercepted sets; it never bounds the guard window. A `case model.demo_mode` in a previous arm within 35 lines satisfies the check — exactly the cross-arm bleed r2 reproduced and the r3 bar forbids ('depth-aware arm boundaries; a cross-arm guard does NOT satisfy'). The hardening did not land.
recommended_fix: Bound the window at the detected arm start (the j index) instead of idx-35, or track case-depth; add the cross-arm bite-test asserting an unguarded call below a neighbouring arm's demo guard fails.

title: Demo interactions still write demo ids into the real product's web-storage keys (r2 note unfixed)
detail: UserToggledComparison/UserClearedComparison/UserDismissedSweepNudge have no demo_update.handle arm, so in demo these write synthetic ids to the shared rt_comparison_ids session key and rt_dismissed_sweep_nudges_v2 localStorage key — demo state reaching real storage, against the 'no persistence of any kind' scope guard. Impact is low: fixture ids never match real rows.
recommended_fix: Gate save_comparison_ids/save_dismissed_sweep_nudges on model.demo_mode, or strip demo-prefixed ids on hydrate; alternatively intercept the three messages in demo_update.handle.

title: Latent: policy re-acceptance modal surfaced inside demo would fire a real auth_api.accept_policy POST
evidence:
UserAcceptedPolicy ->
      case model.policy_reaccept_loading {
        True -> #(model, effect.none())
        False -> #(
          Model(..model, policy_reaccept_loading: True),
          auth_api.accept_policy(
            version: model.server_policy_version,
            csrf_token: model.csrf_token,
detail: demo_update.handle has no UserAcceptedPolicy arm and the lint exempts it under 'demo mode is always False here', but the modal path never exits demo. Today gated by fixture accepted_policy_version == policy_highlights.version and bogus demo csrf_token (fails closed server-side); a logged-in landlord demoing after a policy bump would hit it. Conformance test pins a literal, not the shared const.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update.handle (no-op), and assert fixture accepted_policy_version against policy_highlights.version (not a string literal) in fixtures_conformance_test.
